safe.title: What sign-in does and does not do
items: You type your password on Steam's own site. When you click, check the address bar: the page is steamcommunity.com. Feudal League never sees the password.
Steam sends the site only the public number of your profile (SteamID). It is the same number anyone sees in your profile link.
The site has no access to your inventory, friends, purchases, trades or games. It asks for no Steam permission and uses no Steam API key.
We store the SteamID, the nickname and a session cookie in this browser. No password, e-mail or card. Signing out deletes the cookie.
safe.source: Open source: check it on GitHub

leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.intro: A league groups players into divisions by rating band. Your division stays frozen until the season ends: in the Global League, that happens every month. Points for wins and losses depend on the league.
leagues.globalHint: Open to everyone. Join and show up in your band's table.
leagues.createHint: Your crew, your Discord, your city. You set the bands.
leagues.loginToCreate: Sign in with Steam to create a league.
leagues.empty: No leagues besides the global one yet.
leagues.noMatches: No matches between members yet. Play a 1v1 and it shows up here on the next sync.

rules.title: How it works
rules.placement: Your division is set by your all-time peak RM 1v1 rating, not your current one. If you've been high, you can't enter a low band.
rules.detect: Any 1v1 between two members of the same division counts automatically: ranked or lobby, no reporting.
rules.detectLobby: Only lobby games between two members of the same division count. Ranked games are excluded.
rules.detectAll: Every 1v1 between two members of the same division counts automatically, ranked or not: lobby, Empire Wars and other modes, no reporting.
rules.detectRanked: Only ranked 1v1 (RM) between two members of the same division counts. Lobby and other modes are excluded.
rules.detectNonMembersExtra: Your ranked 1v1 against a non-member rated within your bracket also counts.
rules.points: Win {win} points, loss {loss}. Tiebreaks: wins, then head-to-head, fewest matches and first to reach the score.
rules.season: Your division stays frozen until the season ends. Then everyone is re-placed by their current rating.
rules.detectNonMembers: Your ranked 1v1 against any player rated within your bracket counts, in the league or not. Between members of the same division, lobby counts too.
rules.autoJoin: Whoever plays against a member is brought into the league, up to {max, number} members, and placed in their division. Beyond that, only players who ask can join.
rules.claimJoin: Claiming your profile joins this league automatically. You can leave any time.
rules.placementGlobal: Your division comes from your current RM 1v1 rating, at most one below your peak's. Players who have been high can't drop too far.
rules.seasonGlobal: The league is monthly. Your division stays frozen until the end of the month; on the 1st the table resets and everyone is re-placed.
rules.podiumGlobal: The top 3 in each division, with at least {min} matches in the month, get the month's medal on their profile.

analysis.intro: The portal downloads the official recorded game, summarizes what each player did and asks a language model for feedback aimed at you.

analysis.disclaimer: The recording stores commands, not game state. Timings and decisions are exact; resources in stock and idle villagers are inferences.
